static_consumer_integration_checks: Popen uses start_new_session=True; authoritative binding is attempted immediately and the exact retained anchor is supplied to every RSS read.
Missing or malformed group telemetry stops the owned worker; no-members uses a fresh Popen.poll().
Summed owned-group RSS is checked against the existing limit; no outer PID is used as a signal target.
New v17 cleanup checks both bounded TERM and KILL phases and records group absence or telemetry-confirmed terminal-only members.
Failure to confirm cleanup is retained and blocks future command/block launches in the same run; remaining source blocks stay in the declared denominator.
The authored runner delegates to the v17 consumer and retains its two controls; original markup, rendering, page/output caps and shared resource policy are unchanged.

cases: Exited leader with a persistent live owned member must still receive TERM and KILL and returns unconfirmed cleanup.
An observed terminal-only owned group or absent group returns confirmed cleanup.
Signals use the original inner process-group ID.
An unconfirmed cleanup latches a failure; a subsequent command and remaining block launch no worker.

v17_change_scope: Only explicit cleanup-confirmation/fail-stop amendment and v17 schema/path declarations; no source rewrite, selection or rendering-policy relaxation.
